passages.text: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers: From the Korahites: Meshelemiah son of Kore, one of the sons of Asaph.
passages.sermon:
The gatekeepers had divisions.
Some gatekeepers came from the Korahites.
Meshelemiah was a gatekeeper.
Meshelemiah was the son of Kore.
Kore was from the sons of Asaph.
passages.original: לְמַחְלְק֖וֹת לְשֹׁעֲרִ֑ים לַקָּרְחִ֕ים מְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֥הוּ בֶן־ קֹרֵ֖א מִן־ בְּנֵ֥י אָסָֽף׃

passages.text: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth, Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, and Eliehoenai the seventh.
passages.sermon:
Meshelemiah was a gatekeeper from the Korahites.
He was the son of Kore.
Meshelemiah had seven sons.
His first son was Zechariah.
His second son was Jediael.
His third son was Zebadiah.
His fourth son was Jathniel.
His fifth son was Elam.
His sixth son was Jehohanan.
His seventh son was Eliehoenai.
passages.original: וְלִמְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֖הוּ בָּנִ֑ים זְכַרְיָ֤הוּ הַבְּכוֹר֙ יְדִֽיעֲאֵ֣ל הַשֵּׁנִ֔י זְבַדְיָ֙הוּ֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י יַתְנִיאֵ֖ל הָרְבִיעִֽי׃ עֵילָ֤ם הַחֲמִישִׁי֙ יְהוֹחָנָ֣ן הַשִּׁשִּׁ֔י אֶלְיְהוֹעֵינַ֖י הַשְּׁבִיעִֽי׃

passages.text: And Obed-edom also had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sachar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth, Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth. For God had blessed Obed-edom.
passages.sermon:
Obed-edom was a gatekeeper.
Obed-edom had sons.
Shemaiah was his first son.
Jehozabad was his second son.
Joah was his third son.
Sachar was his fourth son.
Nethanel was his fifth son.
Ammiel was his sixth son.
Issachar was his seventh son.
Peullethai was his eighth son.
God blessed Obed-edom.
passages.original: וּלְעֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֖ם בָּנִ֑ים שְׁמַֽעְיָ֤ה הַבְּכוֹר֙ יְהוֹזָבָ֣ד הַשֵּׁנִ֔י יוֹאָ֤ח הַשְּׁלִשִׁי֙ וְשָׂכָ֣ר הָרְבִיעִ֔י וּנְתַנְאֵ֖ל הַחֲמִישִֽׁי׃ עַמִּיאֵ֤ל הַשִּׁשִּׁי֙ יִשָׂשכָ֣ר הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י פְּעֻלְּתַ֖י הַשְּׁמִינִ֑י כִּ֥י בֵרֲכ֖וֹ אֱלֹהִֽים׃פ

passages.text: Also to his son Shemaiah were born sons who ruled over their families because they were strong, capable men.
passages.sermon:
Shemaiah was the son of Obed-edom.
Shemaiah had sons.
These sons became leaders over their families.
They ruled their families.
They were strong men.
They were capable men.
passages.original: וְלִֽשְׁמַֽעְיָ֤ה בְנוֹ֙ נוֹלַ֣ד בָּנִ֔ים הַמִּמְשָׁלִ֖ים לְבֵ֣ית אֲבִיהֶ֑ם כִּֽי־ גִבּ֥וֹרֵי חַ֖יִל הֵֽמָּה׃

passages.text: Shemaiah’s sons were Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad; his brothers were Elihu and Semachiah, also capable men.
passages.sermon:
Shemaiah had sons.
Their names were Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad.
Shemaiah also had brothers.
Their names were Elihu and Semachiah.
Elihu and Semachiah were capable men.
Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad were also capable men.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֣י שְׁמַֽעְיָ֗ה עָ֠תְנִי וּרְפָאֵ֨ל וְעוֹבֵ֧ד אֶלְזָבָ֛ד אֶחָ֖יו בְּנֵי־ חָ֑יִל אֱלִיה֖וּ וּסְמַכְיָֽהוּ׃

passages.text: All these were descendants of Obed-edom; they and their sons and brothers were capable men with strength to do the work—62 in all from Obed-edom.
passages.sermon:
Obed-edom was the ancestor of these men.
They were his sons and his brothers.
They were strong men.
They were capable men.
They had strength to do the work.
There were sixty-two men in all from Obed-edom.
passages.original: כָּל־ אֵ֜לֶּה מִבְּנֵ֣י׀ עֹבֵ֣ד אֱדֹ֗ם הֵ֤מָּה וּבְנֵיהֶם֙ וַאֲחֵיהֶ֔ם אִֽישׁ־ חַ֥יִל בַּכֹּ֖חַ לַעֲבֹדָ֑ה שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וּשְׁנַ֖יִם לְעֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹֽם׃

passages.text: Meshelemiah also had sons and brothers who were capable men—18 in all.
passages.sermon:
Meshelemiah was a leader among the gatekeepers.
He had sons.
He had brothers.
All of them were capable men.
There were eighteen of them in total.
passages.original: וְלִמְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֗הוּ בָּנִ֧ים וְאַחִ֛ים בְּנֵי־ חָ֖יִל שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃ס

passages.text: Hosah the Merarite also had sons: Shimri the first (although he was not the firstborn, his father had appointed him as the first), Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth. The sons and brothers of Hosah numbered 13 in all.
passages.sermon:
Hosah was a descendant of Merari.
Hosah had sons.
Shimri was the first among Hosah’s sons.
Shimri was not the firstborn.
Hosah, the father, appointed Shimri as the first.
Hilkiah was the second son.
Tebaliah was the third son.
Zechariah was the fourth son.
Hosah had sons and brothers.
The total number of Hosah’s sons and brothers was thirteen.
passages.original: וּלְחֹסָ֥ה מִן־ בְּנֵי־ מְרָרִ֖י בָּנִ֑ים שִׁמְרִ֤י הָרֹאשׁ֙ כִּ֣י לֹא־ הָיָ֣ה בְכ֔וֹר וַיְשִׂימֵ֥הוּ אָבִ֖יהוּ לְרֹֽאשׁ׃ חִלְקִיָּ֤הוּ הַשֵּׁנִי֙ טְבַלְיָ֣הוּ הַשְּׁלִשִׁ֔י זְכַרְיָ֖הוּ הָרְבִעִ֑י כָּל־ בָּנִ֧ים וְאַחִ֛ים לְחֹסָ֖ה שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃

passages.text: These divisions of the gatekeepers, through their chief men, had duties for ministering in the house of the LORD, just as their brothers did.
passages.sermon:
The gatekeepers had different groups.
Each group had a chief man.
These chief men led their groups.
Each group had duties in the house of the LORD.
Their brothers also served in the house of the LORD.
All of them worked together to serve God in His house.
passages.original: לְ֠אֵלֶּה מַחְלְק֨וֹת הַשֹּֽׁעֲרִ֜ים לְרָאשֵׁ֧י הַגְּבָרִ֛ים מִשְׁמָר֖וֹת לְעֻמַּ֣ת אֲחֵיהֶ֑ם לְשָׁרֵ֖ת בְּבֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: They cast lots for each gate, according to their families, young and old alike.
passages.sermon:
The gatekeepers served in the house of the LORD.
They divided their duties by families.
They cast lots for each gate.
They included both young and old in this process.
Each family received a gate by casting lots.
passages.original: וַיַּפִּ֨ילוּ גוֹרָל֜וֹת כַּקָּטֹ֧ן כַּגָּד֛וֹל לְבֵ֥ית אֲבוֹתָ֖ם לְשַׁ֥עַר וָשָֽׁעַר׃פ

passages.text: The lot for the East Gate fell to Shelemiah. Then lots were cast for his son Zechariah, a wise counselor, and the lot for the North Gate fell to him.
passages.sermon:
Shelemiah was a chief gatekeeper.
The leaders cast lots to assign duties at the gates of the house of the LORD.
The lot for the East Gate fell to Shelemiah.
Zechariah was Shelemiah’s son.
Zechariah was a wise counselor.
They cast lots for Zechariah.
The lot for the North Gate fell to Zechariah.
passages.original: וַיִּפֹּ֧ל הַגּוֹרָ֛ל מִזְרָ֖חָה לְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֑הוּ וּזְכַרְיָ֨הוּ בְנ֜וֹ יוֹעֵ֣ץ׀ בְּשֶׂ֗כֶל הִפִּ֙ילוּ֙ גּֽוֹרָל֔וֹת וַיֵּצֵ֥א גוֹרָל֖וֹ צָפֽוֹנָה׃ס

passages.text: The lot for the South Gate fell to Obed-edom, and the lot for the storehouses to his sons.
passages.sermon:
Obed-edom was a gatekeeper.
The lot for the South Gate fell to Obed-edom.
Obed-edom had sons.
The lot for the storehouses fell to his sons.
passages.original: לְעֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֖ם נֶ֑גְבָּה וּלְבָנָ֖יו בֵּ֥ית הָאֲסֻפִּֽים׃

passages.text: The lots for the West Gate and the Shallecheth Gate on the ascending highway fell to Shuppim and Hosah. There were guards stationed at every watch.
passages.sermon:
Shuppim and Hosah were gatekeepers.
The lot for the West Gate fell to them.
The lot for the Shallecheth Gate on the ascending highway also fell to them.
Guards stood at every watch.
Each guard watched opposite another guard.
passages.original: לְשֻׁפִּ֤ים וּלְחֹסָה֙ לַֽמַּעֲרָ֔ב עִ֚ם שַׁ֣עַר שַׁלֶּ֔כֶת בַּֽמְסִלָּ֖ה הָעוֹלָ֑ה מִשְׁמָ֖ר לְעֻמַּ֥ת מִשְׁמָֽר׃

passages.text: Each day there were six Levites on the east, four on the north, four on the south, and two pairs at the storehouse.
passages.sermon:
The Levites served as gatekeepers at the temple.
Each day, six Levites stood on the east side.
Each day, four Levites stood on the north side.
Each day, four Levites stood on the south side.
At the storehouse, two pairs of Levites stood guard each day.
passages.original: לַמִּזְרָח֮ הַלְוִיִּ֣ם שִׁשָּׁה֒ לַצָּפ֤וֹנָה לַיּוֹם֙ אַרְבָּעָ֔ה לַנֶּ֥גְבָּה לַיּ֖וֹם אַרְבָּעָ֑ה וְלָאֲסֻפִּ֖ים שְׁנַ֥יִם שְׁנָֽיִם׃

passages.text: As for the court on the west, there were four at the highway and two at the court.
passages.sermon: The court was on the west side.\r\nFour guards stood at the highway.\r\nTwo guards stood at the court.
passages.original: לַפַּרְבָּ֖ר לַֽמַּעֲרָ֑ב אַרְבָּעָה֙ לַֽמְסִלָּ֔ה שְׁנַ֖יִם לַפַּרְבָּֽר׃

passages.text: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers who were descendants of Korah and Merari.
passages.sermon:
The gatekeepers had different groups.
These groups were called divisions.
The gatekeepers came from two families.
One family was the descendants of Korah.
The other family was the descendants of Merari.
passages.original: אֵ֗לֶּה מַחְלְקוֹת֙ הַשֹּׁ֣עֲרִ֔ים לִבְנֵ֥י הַקָּרְחִ֖י וְלִבְנֵ֥י מְרָרִֽי׃

passages.text: Now their fellow Levites were in charge of the treasuries of the house of God and the treasuries of the dedicated things.
passages.sermon: The Levites were responsible for important duties.\r\nThey were in charge of the treasuries of the house of God.\r\nThey also managed the treasuries of the dedicated things.
passages.original: וְֽהַלְוִיִּ֑ם אֲחִיָּ֗ה עַל־ אֽוֹצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וּלְאֹֽצְר֖וֹת הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃

passages.text: From the descendants of Ladan, who were Gershonites through Ladan and heads of the families of Ladan the Gershonite, were Jehieli, the sons of Jehieli, Zetham, and his brother Joel. They were in charge of the treasuries of the house of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Ladan was a descendant of Gershon.
Ladan belonged to the Gershonite clan.
Ladan’s family included heads of families among the Gershonites.
Jehieli was one of these heads of families.
Jehieli had sons.
Zetham was a son of Jehieli.
Joel was Zetham’s brother.
Zetham and Joel were in charge of the treasuries of the house of the LORD.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֣י לַ֠עְדָּן בְּנֵ֨י הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֜י לְלַעְדָּ֗ן רָאשֵׁ֧י הָאָב֛וֹת לְלַעְדָּ֥ן הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֖י יְחִיאֵלִֽי׃ בְּנֵ֖י יְחִֽיאֵלִ֑י זֵתָם֙ וְיוֹאֵ֣ל אָחִ֔יו עַל־ אֹצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: From the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites: Shebuel, a descendant of Gershom son of Moses, was the officer in charge of the treasuries.
passages.sermon:
The Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites were Levite families.
Shebuel belonged to these Levite families.
Shebuel was a descendant of Gershom.
Gershom was the son of Moses.
Shebuel was the officer in charge of the treasuries.
passages.original: לַֽעַמְרָמִי֙ לַיִּצְהָרִ֔י לַֽחֶבְרוֹנִ֖י לָֽעָזִּיאֵלִֽי׃ וּשְׁבֻאֵל֙ בֶּן־ גֵּרְשׁ֣וֹם בֶּן־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה נָגִ֖יד עַל־ הָאֹצָרֽוֹת׃

passages.text: His relatives through Eliezer included Rehabiah his son, Jeshaiah his son, Joram his son, Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.
passages.sermon:
Eliezer had several descendants.
Rehabiah was Eliezer’s son.
Jeshaiah was the son of Rehabiah.
Joram was the son of Jeshaiah.
Zichri was the son of Joram.
Shelomith was the son of Zichri.
These men were all relatives through Eliezer.
passages.original: וְאֶחָ֖יו לֶֽאֱלִיעֶ֑זֶר רְחַבְיָ֨הוּ בְנ֜וֹ וִֽישַׁעְיָ֤הוּ בְנוֹ֙ וְיֹרָ֣ם בְּנ֔וֹ וְזִכְרִ֥י בְנ֖וֹ וּשְׁלֹמוֹת בְּנֽוֹ׃

passages.text: This Shelomith and his brothers were in charge of all the treasuries for the things dedicated by King David, by the heads of families who were the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and by the army commanders.
passages.sermon:
Shelomith was a leader from the Levite families.
His brothers worked with him.
They were in charge of all the treasuries.
These treasuries held things dedicated to God.
King David dedicated many of these things.
The heads of families also dedicated things.
These heads of families were commanders of thousands and of hundreds.
The army commanders also dedicated things.
Shelomith and his brothers managed everything that was dedicated.
passages.original: ה֧וּא שְׁלֹמ֣וֹת וְאֶחָ֗יו עַ֣ל כָּל־ אֹצְר֤וֹת הַקֳּדָשִׁים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִקְדִּ֜ישׁ דָּוִ֣יד הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וְרָאשֵׁ֧י הָאָב֛וֹת לְשָׂרֵֽי־ הָאֲלָפִ֥ים וְהַמֵּא֖וֹת וְשָׂרֵ֥י הַצָּבָֽא׃

passages.text: They had dedicated some of the plunder from their battles to the repair of the house of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Shelomith and his brothers managed the treasuries.
They received plunder from battles.
They dedicated some of this plunder.
They used it to repair the house of the LORD.
passages.original: מִן־ הַמִּלְחָמ֥וֹת וּמִן־ הַשָּׁלָ֖ל הִקְדִּ֑ישׁוּ לְחַזֵּ֖ק לְבֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Everything that had been dedicated by Samuel the seer, Saul son of Kish, Abner son of Ner, and Joab son of Zeruiah, along with everything else that was dedicated, was under the care of Shelomith and his brothers.
passages.sermon:
Shelomith and his brothers had an important job.
They took care of all the dedicated treasures.
Samuel was a seer.
Samuel dedicated some things.
Saul was the son of Kish.
Saul dedicated some things.
Abner was the son of Ner.
Abner dedicated some things.
Joab was the son of Zeruiah.
Joab dedicated some things.
Other people also dedicated things.
Shelomith and his brothers watched over everything that was dedicated.
passages.original: וְכֹ֨ל הַֽהִקְדִּ֜ישׁ שְׁמוּאֵ֤ל הָרֹאֶה֙ וְשָׁא֣וּל בֶּן־ קִ֔ישׁ וְאַבְנֵ֣ר בֶּן־ נֵ֔ר וְיוֹאָ֖ב בֶּן־ צְרוּיָ֑ה כֹּ֚ל הַמַּקְדִּ֔ישׁ עַ֥ל יַד־ שְׁלֹמִ֖ית וְאֶחָֽיו׃פ

passages.text: From the Izrahites, Chenaniah and his sons had the outside duties as officers and judges over Israel.
passages.sermon:
The Izrahites were a group in Israel.
Chenaniah was an Izrahite.
Chenaniah had sons.
Chenaniah and his sons had special duties.
Their duties were outside duties.
They served as officers over Israel.
They also served as judges over Israel.
passages.original: לַיִּצְהָרִ֞י כְּנַנְיָ֣הוּ וּבָנָ֗יו לַמְּלָאכָ֤ה הַחִֽיצוֹנָה֙ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְשֹׁטְרִ֖ים וּלְשֹׁפְטִֽים׃

passages.text: From the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his relatives, 1,700 capable men, had charge of the affairs of Israel west of the Jordan for all the work of the LORD and for the service of the king.
passages.sermon:
The Hebronites were a group of Israelites.
Hashabiah was a leader among the Hebronites.
Hashabiah had 1,700 relatives who were capable men.
These men were responsible for the affairs of Israel.
They worked west of the Jordan River.
They managed all the work of the LORD.
They also served the king.
passages.original: לַֽחֶבְרוֹנִ֡י חֲשַׁבְיָהוּ֩ וְאֶחָ֨יו בְּנֵי־ חַ֜יִל אֶ֣לֶף וּשְׁבַע־ מֵא֗וֹת עַ֚ל פְּקֻדַּ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵעֵ֥בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן מַעְרָ֑בָה לְכֹל֙ מְלֶ֣אכֶת יְהוָ֔ה וְלַעֲבֹדַ֖ת הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: As for the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites, according to the genealogies of his ancestors. In the fortieth year of David’s reign the records were searched, and strong, capable men were found among the Hebronites at Jazer in Gilead.
passages.sermon:
Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites.
The Hebronites were a group in Israel.
Jerijah was chief according to the genealogies of his ancestors.
In the fortieth year of King David’s reign, officials searched the records.
They found strong and capable men among the Hebronites.
These men were at Jazer in Gilead.
passages.original: לַֽחֶבְרוֹנִי֙ יְרִיָּ֣ה הָרֹ֔אשׁ לַֽחֶבְרוֹנִ֥י לְתֹלְדֹתָ֖יו לְאָב֑וֹת בִּשְׁנַ֨ת הָֽאַרְבָּעִ֜ים לְמַלְכ֤וּת דָּוִיד֙ נִדְרָ֔שׁוּ וַיִּמָּצֵ֥א בָהֶ֛ם גִּבּ֥וֹרֵי חַ֖יִל בְּיַעְזֵ֥יר גִּלְעָֽד׃

passages.text: Among Jerijah’s relatives there were 2,700 capable men who were heads of families. King David appointed them over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh for every matter pertaining to God and to the affairs of the king.
passages.sermon:
Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites.
Jerijah had relatives who were strong and capable men.
There were 2,700 of these men.
They were heads of families.
King David appointed these men to positions of authority.
They had responsibility over the Reubenites.
They also had responsibility over the Gadites.
They also had responsibility over the half-tribe of Manasseh.
They managed every matter that pertained to God.
They also managed every matter that pertained to the king.
passages.original: וְאֶחָ֣יו בְּנֵי־ חַ֗יִל אַלְפַּ֛יִם וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת רָאשֵׁ֣י הָאָב֑וֹת וַיַּפְקִידֵ֞ם דָּוִ֣יד הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ עַל־ הָראוּבֵנִ֤י וְהַגָּדִי֙ וַחֲצִי֙ שֵׁ֣בֶט הַֽמְנַשִּׁ֔י לְכָל־ דְּבַ֥ר הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים וּדְבַ֥ר הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃פ
